summary: Each edition was independently reviewed against every clause of the selected working Greek. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the rod groups, repentance timing, tower/walls distinction, negations, renewed-division condition, and emphatic death warning. The notes distinguish bracketed editorial reporting supplements from unbracketed expressions and disclose the supplied reports concerning future repentance and elliptical rivalry without claiming complete preserved witness wording. Contextual repentance terminology follows current policy. Acceptance concerns these supplied drafts and their disclosures, not authentication of unseen manuscripts, exhaustive collation, or scholarly certification.
